resources.string:
Tapping a word sends the selected fragment to:
• api.dictionaryapi.dev (definitions)
• api.mymemory.translated.net (translation)
• your AI provider (Gemini / OpenAI / Claude / DeepSeek, only when you request an explanation)

You can turn this off anytime in Settings → Privacy & Cloud Lookups.
Cloud lookups are off. Enable them in Settings to see definitions.
Cloud lookups are off. Enable them in Settings for AI explanations.
Word tap sends the selected fragment to: dictionaryapi.dev, mymemory.translated.net and your selected AI provider (Gemini / OpenAI / Claude / DeepSeek). No text leaves the device while this is off.
On — fragments are sent to the services above
